compute.cost_note: network-bound; robots.txt honored with a per-host rate limit; feed plus archive/sitemap fetches, capped by --max-posts (default 50)

do_not_use_when: you have a Google Takeout Blogger export (use acquire_blogger_takeout, which reads the full archive offline)
the source is not a blog-shaped feed or archive; adapt a new acquirer from the corpus-acquisition pattern instead
you cannot state a consent_status for the third-party prose

examples.description: Acquire a Substack archive into a register-matched impostor pool

inputs.target: blog or Substack root URL (positional url)

artifacts: draft_manifest.jsonl for review before merging into corpus_manifest.jsonl

purpose: pull one author's blog or Substack archive (Substack, WordPress/Ghost feed, generic HTML archive, or Wayback Machine CDX snapshots) into the private impostor pool, or into the validation bucket with --bucket validation, writing cleaned .txt + .meta.json pairs and a draft manifest.
use_when: building a register-matched impostor pool from a named writer's public blog or Substack archive
adding your own AI-involved blog writing to the validation spine (--bucket validation with --ai-status)
recovering a shut-down blog through the Wayback Machine (--wayback)
